facts.fact: Starlink satellite internet has been officially available in Senegal since February 2026, with monthly subscriptions estimated at CFA22,000 to CFA30,000 excluding equipment.

In August 2023 several individuals were arrested in Senegal for selling Starlink-enabling terminals without prior authorisation; ARTP warned on 2026-03-31 that reselling or sharing Starlink connections as community WiFi without a licence is illegal.
